items.label: Fabric
items.value: Made of 60%Cotton+38%Polyester+2%Spandex, lightweight and breathable,Whether it’s the relaxed harem style, flowy palazzo, wide leg silhouette, casual barrel sweatpants, or baggy slacks, the material offers a soft touch against the skin.

items.label: Designs
items.value: Women's lounge pants designed with wide leg,inner drawstring and pockets,perfect for breezy summer nights or garden parties. The barrel sweatpants combine comfort and style for lazy summer lounging or running quick errands. No matter your mood, there’s a style to match.

items.label: Occasions
items.value: Wear the gaucho pants for a casual day at the beach, paired with a bikini top and flip - flops. Boho pants are perfect for a day of shopping, while palazzo and wide leg styles work well for evening summer events with the right accessories.

items.label: Matching
items.value: These pants are the epitome of casual chic for summer. The baggy slacks pair effortlessly with a simple tank top and sandals for a bohemian vibe, look great with a cute crop top and sneakers for a sporty - casual feel. Even the barrel sweatpants can be styled with a denim jacket for a trendy, relaxed outfit.
